name: @mplot/viewer
description: Dependency-light interactive browser viewer for MPlot artifacts

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && cp src/style.css app/index.html dist/ && cp node_modules/fzstd/esm/index.mjs dist/fzstd.js && sed -i.bak 's/from "fzstd"/from ".\/fzstd.js"/' dist/loader.js && rm -f dist/loader.js.bak
